Windows Night Mode: reduced compressor makeup gain 1.4 to 1.0 and enabled 5.1-to-stereo downmix normalization while Night Mode is ON, reducing clipping risk. OFF restores normal mixing. New Windows Settings Debug Mode checkbox defaults OFF: no Night Mode log writes and no player log-path icon unless explicitly enabled. Existing logs are retained. No change to 3:1 compression, subtitles or playback speed. iOS IPA unchanged. Physical audio peak/clipping not yet measured.
